candidate.answerReason: The two interior angles sum to 100° and have ratio 3:1, so ∠BOC=100°÷4=25°.

methods.label: Use a simple equation
methods.explanation: Let \(\angle BOC=x\). Then \(\angle AOC=3x\), so \(x+3x=100^\circ\). Solving gives \(x=25^\circ\).
methods.levelReason: Angle addition and solving x+3x=100° are within Grade 7; letters and equality properties support the equation.

methods.label: Divide into equal parts
methods.explanation:
Because \(OC\) lies inside \(\angle AOB\), the two smaller angles together measure \(100^\circ\). The angle \(\angle AOC\) contains three parts of the size of \(\angle BOC\), so the whole angle contains four equal parts. Therefore
\[
\angle BOC=100^\circ\div(3+1)=25^\circ.
\]
methods.levelReason: The method combines Grade 7 angle addition with Grade 6 proportional allocation and earlier multiplication and division concepts.
